positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior software engineer, UCSD
Scripps Institute of Oceanography 2016-now.  XML database for acoustic oceanographic applications. Database design and implementation in PYTHON and Matlab. Big data analysis and database curation for marine mammal acoustic database. 
Bioengineering Department 2013-16. Database, web services and web pages for systems biology. Developed PHP/MYSQL and PYTHON/POSTGRES databases for storage and retrieval of metabolic models. Algorithm design and development in Python and Matlab for metabolic modeling and big data analysis. Metabolic modeling of diatom and omics integration for bioenergy applications. Design, configuration and management of Linux/Mac/Win computing resources for fifty member Systems Biology Research Group.
